罗德岛小队已接应: The Rhodes Island squad has picked up
Stormeye。他还在替我们拖住追兵。……罗德岛离开这座城之前，必须把他带回来: Stormeye. He is still holding off our pursuers... We must bring him back before Rhodes Island leaves this city.
交易所交给我吧。拿物资换消息，这买卖我跟凯尔希医生做了好多年。: Leave the exchange to me. Supplies for information — Dr. Kal'tsit and I have done that trade for years.
仓库的空间……我能让它比看上去大一点。别问原理。: The warehouse space... I can make it a little bigger than it looks. Don't ask how.
他们负责的部门现在都停着。先学会活着回来，博士，然后再去把人找回来。: The departments they ran are all at a standstill. Learn to come back alive first, Doctor, then go and bring them home.
你们来了。这片冻土下面还有活着的根……可惜没时间研究了。: You came. There are still living roots under this frozen ground... a pity there's no time to study them.
你的判断还是那么准，博士。我还以为再也见不到罗德岛的舰灯了。: Your judgement is as sharp as ever, Doctor. I thought I'd never see Rhodes Island's lights again.
切尔诺伯格废墟内检测到一个罗德岛识别信号。来源：第 5 至 9 层之间。: A Rhodes Island identification signal detected in the Chernobog ruins. Source: between floors 5 and 9.
别那样看着我，博士，我不是刺客。只是不想被发现而已。: Don't look at me like that, Doctor. I'm not an assassin. I just didn't want to be found.
加工部？热力学在上，那些机床被谁拆成这样的……给我一天。: The Processing Dept.? Thermodynamics above, who took those machines apart like this... Give me a day.
博士。……这份工作比预想的拖得久了一点。: Doctor. ...This job ran a bit longer than expected.
博士，二层的农业舱修好了！可是没人会照顾作物……萨米那边，还有 Touch 小姐: Doctor, the farm deck on the second level is fixed! But nobody knows how to tend the crops... and there's still Ms. Touch's signal out in Sami.
哈，博士亲自来接我？在伊比利亚，我可没这待遇。: Ha, the Doctor came for me in person? I never got that treatment in Iberia.
哦，博士！工作服的电量只剩三格了，你们来得刚好。: Oh, Doctor! My work suit is down to three bars — you came just in time.
嘿嘿……被找到了。博士，你的信号我隔着好几层就感觉到了。: Hehe... found me. Doctor, I could feel your signal from several floors away.
大家……都回来了。博士，谢谢您。: Everyone... is back. Doctor, thank you.
失散的干员被敌人包围了。清理她周围的敌人，然后靠近她按 E。: The missing operator is surrounded. Clear the enemies around her, then go up to her and press E.
归队的干员回到了罗德岛，会在舰上走动。她负责的部门可以重新运转了。: Returned operators are back on Rhodes Island and walk the ship. The department she runs can work again.
整备部我来接手。装备、训练，都按规矩来——这是工作。: I'll take over the Outfitting Dept. Gear and training, all by the book — it's the job.
是 Sharp 先生！近卫干员的训练一直是他在带……博士，我们去接他回来吧。: It's Mr. Sharp! He's always trained our Guards... Doctor, let's go bring him back.
是电弧小姐……罗德岛的通讯一直是她在维护。难怪最近信号这么乱。: It's Ms. Raidian... she has always kept Rhodes Island's comms running. No wonder the signals have been such a mess.
最后一个信号，叙拉古第 25 至 29 层之间。信号源周围交火频繁。: The last signal, between Siracusa floors 25 and 29. Heavy fighting around the source.
有人管训练，我就能专心盯着出勤的人了。博士，别让他失望。: With someone on training, I can keep my eyes on the field teams. Doctor, don't let him down.
来得正好。后面的追兵，我已经替你们拖了很久了。: Good timing. I've been holding off your pursuers for a long while.
检测到失散的罗德岛干员的识别信号。她就在这一层，位置已标在小地图上。: Identification signal of a missing Rhodes Island operator detected. She is on this floor; her position is marked on the minimap.
种子在铁做的船里也能发芽。农业舱和食堂，我会照看。: Seeds can sprout even in a ship of iron. I'll look after the farm deck and the canteen.
科研部交给我。源石技艺的解析，我带人从头做起。: Leave the Research Dept. to me. I'll rebuild Originium Arts analysis from the ground up.
突围时失散的特派干员。失散的一栏写着她最后的信号来自哪个地区、哪几层。: Special operators lost in the breakout. A missing one shows the region and floors her last signal came from.
突围的时候，Sharp 先生他们带队留在地面掩护我们……和罗德岛失散了。: During the breakout, Mr. Sharp and the others stayed on the ground to cover us... and were cut off from Rhodes Island.
第二个信号，切尔诺伯格第 14 至 18 层之间。信号很弱，而且一直在移动。: A second signal, between Chernobog floors 14 and 18. It's weak, and it keeps moving.
罗德岛小队已接应干员。她已经归队，之后撤退或倒下都不受影响；她负责的部门可以重新: The Rhodes Island squad has picked her up. She is back on board; a later retreat or fall changes nothing. The department she runs can work again.
航线已确认。龙门、萨米、叙拉古方向各有一个识别信号。: Route confirmed. One identification signal each toward Lungmen, Sami and Siracusa.
航线我来看。哪里危险我最清楚，因为我总往那儿去。: I'll watch the route. I know where the danger is better than anyone — I always head there.
这个部门的负责干员还没有归队。找到她，部门才能重新运转。: This department's operator in charge is not back yet. Find her and the department can work again.
通讯频段我来重新校准。情报那边也交给我吧，信息要讲究效率。: I'll recalibrate the comms bands. Leave intelligence to me too — information is all about efficiency.
郁金香。她习惯一个人扛着。……博士，你得亲自去。: Tulip. She's used to carrying everything alone... Doctor, you'll have to go yourself.
龙门方向出现新的识别信号，第 15 至 19 层之间。信号经过加密，是罗德岛的旧: A new identification signal toward Lungmen, between floors 15 and 19. It's encrypted on an old Rhodes Island band.
